dataset: FEVER paper_dev.jsonl (first 1,000 SUPPORTS/REFUTES claims with gold evidence)
metric: Recall@K = share of claims where at least one gold Wikipedia page appears in the top K retrieved titles
notes: Earlier notes recorded baseline Recall@1 as 56.50%; this rerun gives 56.40% (likely BM25 tie ordering).
Title retrieval only: finding the right page does not mean the right sentence was found or correctly assessed.
Top-50 candidate coverage (89.2%) and oracle gold-evidence recovery (99.37%) were recorded earlier from console output and were not rerun.
